title: Single-phase internal convection in pipes - turbulent and turbulent entry region Nusselt numbers
description: 23 functions: turbulent_Dittus_Boelter, turbulent_Sieder_Tate, turbulent_entry_Hausen, turbulent_Colburn, turbulent_Drexel_McAdams, turbulent_von_Karman, turbulent_Prandtl, turbulent_Friend_Metzner, turbulent_Petukhov_Kirillov_Popov, turbulent_Webb, turbulent_Sandall, turbulent_Gnielinski, turbulent_Gnielinski_smooth_1, turbulent_Gnielinski_smooth_2, turbulent_Churchill_Zajic, turbulent_ESDU, turbulent_Martinelli, turbulent_Nunner, turbulent_Dipprey_Sabersky, turbulent_Gowen_Smith, turbulent_Kawase_Ulbrecht, turbulent_Kawase_De, turbulent_Bhatti_Shah. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; one FUNCTION per correlation, Nu(Re,Pr,Di/L,f) -> h = Nu*k/Di is left to the caller. refs: Dittus-Boelter 1930 and Gnielinski 1976 (both as given in Rohsenow/Hartnett/Cho Handbook of Heat Transfer 2nd ed. and in Perry's); Sieder-Tate 1937; Colburn 1931; ESDU 73031; Bhatti-Shah 1991 (rough pipe). friction factors are NOT in ht (fluids.friction) - they are inputs of the correlations. overlap: LTP-034 (LaboThapPy in-tube HTC) quotes Dittus-Boelter/Gnielinski; ht is far more complete, keep both. selector not translated: Nu_conv_internal, Nu_conv_internal_methods.

title: Pool nucleate boiling heat flux and critical heat flux (Zuber, Serth-HEDH, HEDH-Montinsky)
description: 12 functions: Rohsenow, McNelly, Forster_Zuber, Montinsky, Stephan_Abdelsalam, HEDH_Taborek, Bier, Cooper, Gorenflo, Zuber, Serth_HEDH, HEDH_Montinsky. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; the 9 boiling correlations return q [W/m^2] on a surface area argument, the 3 CHF correlations also return a heat flux; h [W/m^2/K] = q/(T_wall-T_sat) is left to the caller. refs: Rohsenow 1962; Cooper 1964; Gorenflo 1990 (VDI Heat Atlas); Forster-Zuber 1955; Zuber 1958 (CHF, flat plate); Montinsky 1961; Taborek 1986 (via HEDH). overlap: THC-004 (ThermoCycle, Shah 1979 flow/nucleate boiling) is the closest candidate; the ht family is more complete and includes the CHF limit. selectors not translated: h_nucleic, h_nucleic_methods, qmax_boiling, qmax_boiling_methods.

title: Film condensation - Nusselt laminar plate, Boyko-Kruzhilin, Akers-Deans-Crosser, kinetic correction, Cavallini, Shah
description: 6 functions: Nusselt_laminar, Boyko_Kruzhilin, Akers_Deans_Crosser, h_kinetic, Cavallini_Smith_Zecchin, Shah. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; the 5 HTC correlations return h [W/m^2/K] from the tube diameter, length and inclination; h_kinetic is a multiplicative correction factor for the condensation of a pure chemical. refs: Nusselt 1916 (as given in Hewitt-Shires-Bott); Boyko-Kruzhilin 1968; Akers-Deans-Crosser 1960; Cavallini-Smith-Zecchin 1974; Shah 1979 and Shah 1982. overlap: TSP-009 (TESPy condenser) and CSL-0027/CSL-0031 model the condenser itself, not the HTC correlation; no film-condensation HTC function exists in the library yet.

title: Effectiveness-NTU relations: Cmin/Cmax/Cr, NTU-UA, effectiveness and NTU for counterflow, parallel, crossflow, boiler/condenser
description: 8 functions: calc_Cmin, calc_Cmax, calc_Cr, NTU_from_UA, UA_from_NTU, effectiveness_from_NTU, NTU_from_effectiveness, crossflow_effectiveness_to_int. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=medium; crossflow with a mixed stream needs the modified Bessel functions (fluids.numerics iv, i0, i1, k0, k1) - CHECK that CoolSolve can evaluate them before translating that branch (no gap registered yet). The series limits Cr -> 1 and Cmin -> 0 are singular in the closed form: use the ht limiting expression or an EES IF. refs: Kays & London (Heat Transfer), Incropera et al., VDI Heat Atlas. overlap: TSP-030 (TESPy, same relations), LTP-014/LTP-042 (LaboThapPy eps-NTU + F-LMTD), CSL-0002/CSL-0026/CSL-0027 (eps-NTU models). selectors not translated: effectiveness_NTU_method, P_NTU_method; crossflow_effectiveness_to_int is the helper of the inverse crossflow formula.

title: Single-phase internal convection - laminar, thermal entry region, rectangular duct and curved/helical (spiral) ducts
description: 10 functions: laminar_T_const, laminar_Q_const, laminar_entry_thermal_Hausen, laminar_entry_Seider_Tate, laminar_entry_Baehr_Stephan, Nu_laminar_rectangular_Shan_London, Morimoto_Hotta, helical_turbulent_Nu_Mori_Nakayama, helical_turbulent_Nu_Schmidt, helical_turbulent_Nu_Xin_Ebadian. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; laminar_T_const vs laminar_Q_const differ by the wall condition (constant T_wall vs constant flux); the 3 entry-region correlations use the hydrodynamic entry length (may need fluid properties from CoolProp). refs: Shah & London (laminar flow forced convection, Supp. 1); Hausen 1943; Sieder-Tate 1937; Baehr & Stephan; Shan & London (rectangular duct); Morimoto & Hotta 1994 (spiral); Mori & Nakayama, Schmidt, Xin & Ebadian (helical).

title: Free convection from vertical cylinders (10 correlations) and horizontal cylinders (Churchill-Chu, Kuehn-Goldstein, Morgan)
description: 13 functions: Nu_vertical_cylinder_Griffiths_Davis_Morgan, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Jakob_Linke_Morgan, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Carne_Morgan, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Eigenson_Morgan, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Touloukian_Morgan, Nu_vertical_cylinder_McAdams_Weiss_Saunders, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Kreith_Eckert, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Hanesian_Kalish_Morgan, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Al_Arabi_Khamis, Nu_vertical_cylinder_Popiel_Churchill, Nu_horizontal_cylinder_Churchill_Chu, Nu_horizontal_cylinder_Kuehn_Goldstein, Nu_horizontal_cylinder_Morgan. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; most functions take D, H, dT and Pr or air properties; the 9 vertical-cylinder forms share the Grossman/Morgan presentation. refs: Popiel & Churchill 1963; Churchill & Chu 1975; Kuehn & Goldstein 1973; Morgan (natural convection in VDI Heat Atlas); the vertical-cylinder correlations follow Jakob/Morgan and Al-Arabi & Khamis 1977. overlap: LTP-039 and LTP-038 (LaboThapPy finned-tube / external bundle HTC); the library has no free-convection cylinder function. selectors not translated: Nu_vertical_cylinder(_methods), Nu_horizontal_cylinder(_methods).

title: Free convection from plates and a sphere (Churchill-Chu vertical plate, McAdams/VDI/Rohsenow horizontal plate, Churchill sphere)
description: 5 functions: Nu_vertical_plate_Churchill, Nu_horizontal_plate_McAdams, Nu_horizontal_plate_VDI, Nu_horizontal_plate_Rohsenow, Nu_sphere_Churchill. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; isothermal surfaces; Churchill-Chu uses the all-Rayleigh range, the horizontal-plate correlations cover hot-upper/hot-lower faces. refs: Churchill & Chu 1975; McAdams (Heat Transmission); VDI Heat Atlas (2010); Rohsenow, Hartnett & Cho 1998. overlap: CSL-0065/CSL-0076 (cooling towers, natural convection on surfaces) use their own formulas - cross-check only. selectors not translated: Nu_free_vertical_plate(_methods), Nu_free_horizontal_plate(_methods).

title: Forced convection crossflow over a single cylinder (Zukauskas, Churchill-Bernstein, Sanitjai-Goldstein, Fand, McAdams, Whitaker, Perkins-Leppert)
description: 8 functions: Nu_cylinder_Zukauskas, Nu_cylinder_Churchill_Bernstein, Nu_cylinder_Sanitjai_Goldstein, Nu_cylinder_Fand, Nu_cylinder_McAdams, Nu_cylinder_Whitaker, Nu_cylinder_Perkins_Leppert_1962, Nu_cylinder_Perkins_Leppert_1964. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; all take Re and Pr at the film temperature; Whitaker also takes the D^2/(L D) geometry parameter. refs: Zukauskas 1972 (as in Irvine's Handbook of Heat Transfer); Churchill & Bernstein 1977; Sanitjai & Goldstein 2006 review; Whitaker 1978; Fand 1977; McAdams. overlap: LTP-038 (LaboThapPy external tube banks) uses bundle formulas, not a single cylinder. selectors not translated: Nu_external_cylinder(_methods).

title: Crossflow tube banks - Nusselt numbers and row/angle correction factors (Grimison, Zukauskas, ESDU 73031, HEDH)
description: 7 functions: Nu_Grimison_tube_bank, Zukauskas_tube_row_correction, Nu_Zukauskas_Bejan, ESDU_tube_row_correction, ESDU_tube_angle_correction, Nu_ESDU_73031, Nu_HEDH_tube_bank. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=medium; 3 of the 7 functions read a curve digitised from a graph (Grimison C1/m aligned and staggered, Zukauskas row correction, ESDU row and angle corrections) - ship them as CoolSolve lookup tables (CS-GAP-LOOKUP-PROC if a table has to be read inside a FUNCTION) or keep the plain polynomial form where ht offers one. refs: Grimison (as in Perry's); Zukauskas 1972 and the Bejan fit; ESDU 73031; HEDH (Schlünder). overlap: LTP-037/LTP-038 (LaboThapPy shell-side and external bundle HTC); CSL-0008/CSL-0077 (air-cooled condenser models).

title: Plate heat exchangers - single-phase Nusselt numbers (Kumar, Martin, Muley-Manglik, Khan-Khan) and two-phase plate boiling (Amalfi, Lee-Kang-Kim, Han-Lee-Kim, Huang-Sheer, Yan-Lin)
description: 9 functions: Nu_plate_Kumar, Nu_plate_Martin, Nu_plate_Muley_Manglik, Nu_plate_Khan_Khan, h_boiling_Amalfi, h_boiling_Lee_Kang_Kim, h_boiling_Han_Lee_Kim, h_boiling_Huang_Sheer, h_boiling_Yan_Lin. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; the plate correlations need the plate geometry (chevron angle, gap, corrugation pitch, number of plates); h_boiling_* need quality x and a Lockhart-Martinelli two-phase multiplier (fluids.two_phase_voidage). refs: Martin 2012; Muley & Manglik 2000; Kumar 1989; Khan & Khan 1998; Amalfi et al. 1994/2008; Han, Lee & Kim; Huang & Sheer 1991; Yan & Lin 2003. overlap: LTP-035 (LaboThapPy plate HTC family incl. Martin, Han, Amalfi, Shah) and THC-011 (ThermoCycle single-phase and plate correlations, Martin 2012) - duplicate physics; the ht row is the most complete single list.

title: Two-phase non-boiling (condensing/evaporating) forced convection inside tubes - 9 correlations
description: 9 functions: Davis_David, Elamvaluthi_Srinivas, Groothuis_Hendal, Hughmark, Knott, Kudirka_Grosh_McFadden, Martin_Sims, Ravipudi_Godbold, Aggour. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; each correlation returns h_tp [W/m^2/K] from G, quality x, Re or a Gr/Re^2 combination; Hughmark and Aggour are for horizontal laminar two-phase flow. refs: Groothuis & Hendal 1963; Davis & David 1949; Martin & Sims 1949; Knott & Anderson; Kudirka, Grosh & McFadden 1962; Hughmark 1958; all as reviewed in Kim, Ryali, Ghajar & Petersen (2014). overlap: LTP-034 mentions two-phase in-tube HTC; no such function in the library. selectors not translated: h_two_phase, h_two_phase_methods.

title: Forced-convective (flow) boiling in tubes, including film boiling (Lazarek-Black, Li-Wu, Sun-Mishima, Thome, Yun-Heo-Kim, Chen-Edelstein, Chen-Bennett, Liu-Winterton)
description: 8 functions: Lazarek_Black, Li_Wu, Sun_Mishima, Thome, Yun_Heo_Kim, Chen_Edelstein, Chen_Bennett, Liu_Winterton. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=medium; all return the HTC h_tp [W/m^2/K]; Thome solves its own heat flux internally (ht helper to_solve_q_Thome, secant on q) - in EES make q an extra unknown and write the Thome equation as a simultaneous equation instead of iterating. refs: Lazarek & Black 1988; Li & Wu 1998; Sun & Mishima 2001; Thome, Dupont & Jacobi 1963; Yun, Heo & Kim 2006; Chen, Edelstein & Chen 1997; Bennett & Chen 1985; Liu & Winterton 2001. overlap: THC-004 (Shah 1979 flow boiling) is the closest; keep both, ht is more complete.

title: Air-cooled (finned tube bundle) air-side heat transfer and pressure drop (Briggs-Young, ESDU high/low fin, Ganguli-VDI) + air-cooler noise (GPSA, Mukherjee)
description: 8 functions: h_Briggs_Young, h_ESDU_high_fin, h_ESDU_low_fin, h_Ganguli_VDI, dP_ESDU_high_fin, dP_ESDU_low_fin, air_cooler_noise_GPSA, air_cooler_noise_Mukherjee. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy-medium; the 6 HTC/dP functions are finned-bundle formulas (Briggs & Young 1961-63, ESDU low- and high-fin, Ganguli/VDI 1997); the 2 noise functions return a sound power level [dB] from a fan diameter, flow rate and tip speed - keep them separate from the heat-transfer calls in the demonstration program. The two dP functions are air-side only (they belong to heat_transfer/pressure_drop in the taxonomy). refs: GPSA Engineering Data Book (air-cooler design and noise); ESDU 78003/84014 as presented by GPSA; Ganguli & VDI. overlap: CSL-0008/CSL-0077 (air-cooled condenser models), LTP-039 (finned-tube air-side HTC) and LTP-032 (finned-tube air-side dP) - those models need these functions; ht also provides the Ft of HT-019.

title: Natural convection in enclosures and vessels - parallel plates (Holling-Herwig, Probert, Hollands), vertical plates (Thess), helical coils in tanks (Ali, Prabhanjan, Xin-Ebadian) and vessel jackets (Lehrer, Stein-Schmidt)
description: 12 functions: Nu_Nusselt_Rayleigh_Holling_Herwig, Nu_Nusselt_Rayleigh_Holling_Herwig_err, Nu_Nusselt_Rayleigh_Probert, Nu_Nusselt_Rayleigh_Hollands, Nu_Nusselt_vertical_Thess, Rac_Nusselt_Rayleigh, Rac_Nusselt_Rayleigh_disk, Nu_vertical_helical_coil_Ali, Nu_vertical_helical_coil_Prabhanjan_Rennie_Raghavan, Nu_coil_Xin_Ebadian, Lehrer, Stein_Schmidt. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy-medium; the two Rac_* functions give the critical Rayleigh number above which convection starts (useful as an IF condition); Nu_Nusselt_Rayleigh_Holling_Herwig_err is the same correlation in an error-function form - keep only if CoolSolve can evaluate the error function (check when translating). refs: Hollands & Herwig 1985; Probert & Hollands 1974; Hollands 1983; Thess 1987 (via VDI Heat Atlas); Ali 1974 and Prabhanjan, Rennie & Raghavan 1981 (helical coils); Lehrer 1959 and Stein & Schmidt 1966 (jackets). overlap: CSL-0009/CSL-0041 (vessel storage), CSL-0043 (LiBr chiller with a solution HX) - no correlation function exists.

title: Forced convection over a flat plate - laminar (Baehr-Stephan, Churchill-Ozoe) and turbulent (Schlichting, Kreith)
description: 4 functions: Nu_horizontal_plate_laminar_Baehr, Nu_horizontal_plate_laminar_Churchill_Ozoe, Nu_horizontal_plate_turbulent_Schlichting, Nu_horizontal_plate_turbulent_Kreith. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; only 4 functions (below the 5-20 target): merge into HT-005 or HT-006 if a single library file is preferred. Isothermal plate, laminar correlations over the whole Re range. refs: Baehr & Stephan (Heat and Mass Transfer); Churchill & Ozoe 1977; Schlichting & Gersten (Grenzschicht-Theorie, 9th ed.); Kreith, Manglik & Bohn. selector not translated: Nu_external_horizontal_plate(_methods).

title: Temperature-effectiveness P-NTU method: TEMA E/G/H/J, plate and air-cooler temperature effectiveness and the inverse NTU(P) relations
description: 15 functions: P_NTU_Pp, P_NTU_Pc, temperature_effectiveness_air_cooler, temperature_effectiveness_basic, temperature_effectiveness_TEMA_J, temperature_effectiveness_TEMA_H, temperature_effectiveness_TEMA_G, temperature_effectiveness_TEMA_E, temperature_effectiveness_plate, NTU_from_P_basic, NTU_from_P_G, NTU_from_P_J, NTU_from_P_E, NTU_from_P_H, NTU_from_P_plate. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=medium; the inverse relations NTU_from_P_* solve for NTU with a secant/bisection (ht private helpers _NTU_from_P_solver, _NTU_from_P_erf, _NTU_max_for_P_solver) - in EES write NTU1 as an unknown with the temperature-effectiveness equation as a second simultaneous equation; the Pade bound of _NTU_max_for_P_solver is only a bracket for the iteration and is dropped. refs: TEMA standards; Kays & London; Stoblo-Zajic-Burdette (TEMA G); as in ht hx.py. overlap: TSP-012 (TESPy NTU heat exchanger, forward only); HT-004 holds the forward eps-NTU relations.

title: Shell-and-tube crossflow shell-side pressure drop (Kern, Zukauskas) and the Bell-Delaware correction factors Jc, Jl, Jb, Js, Jr
description: 7 functions: dP_Kern, dP_Zukauskas, baffle_correction_Bell, baffle_leakage_Bell, bundle_bypassing_Bell, unequal_baffle_spacing_Bell, laminar_correction_Bell. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=medium; the 5 Bell-Delaware factors default to a spline of digitized tables (ht ships Chebyshev alternatives) - decide per factor between a lookup table and the polynomial; the library already has single-phase pipe dP (CSL-0018) but no shell-side dP. refs: Kern 1960 (as in Ludwig); Zukauskas 1964; Bell (R.D. Bell, 1967-1978, HLTC method). overlap: LTP-030 (Kern, Donohue, Bell-Delaware in LaboThapPy) - same physics, different parameterisation; keep the ht version (self-contained shell areas).

title: Near-supercritical / supercritical internal convection in vertical upward flow - 18 correlations (McAdams ... Krasnoshchekov)
description: 18 functions: Nu_McAdams, Nu_Shitsman, Nu_Griem, Nu_Jackson, Nu_Gupta, Nu_Swenson, Nu_Xu, Nu_Mokry, Nu_Bringer_Smith, Nu_Ornatsky, Nu_Gorban, Nu_Zhu, Nu_Bishop, Nu_Yamagata, Nu_Kitoh, Nu_Krasnoshchekov_Protopopov, Nu_Petukhov, Nu_Krasnoshchekov. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; each function returns the Nusselt number from Re and the pseudo-critical temperature ratio T_b/T_pc (heat capacity ratio for Petukhov); the pressure and its effect are handled by the correlation itself. refs: McAdams (Heat Transmission 1942); Jackson 1965; Swenson, Carver & Kakarala 1968; Griem 1963; Bringer & Smith 1967; Kitoh, Koshizuka & Oka 1987; Xu et al. 2005; most as collected in Chen, Fang, Xu & Su (2018) and Yu, Jia, Wu & Wang (2017). overlap: LTP-034 mentions an sCO2 HTC; TSP-042/CSL-0038 (sCO2 cycles) would use these functions; THC-005 (in-cylinder correlations) is a different physical case. added as CSL-0104 (T-FUNC C-113): 18 FUNCTIONs, one per correlation, verified vs ht 1.2.0 (doctests + Python; 71 values; max 4.4e-13). decision of the card: the optional Python arguments became mandatory arguments plus the 1/0 flag corr (1 = corrections applied; 0 = bare correlation); the regime switches use nested block IF (no ELSEIF ladder: CS-GAP-ELSEIF-CHAIN; no single-line IF: CS-BUG-IF-SINGLELINE); case C of the demo program covers the branches not taken by A and B; no selector in this module.

title: Log-mean temperature difference, shell-and-tube F correction factor (Fakheri) and air-cooler Ft correction factor
description: 3 functions: LMTD, F_LMTD_Fakheri, Ft_aircooler. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; only 3 functions (below target): consider merging into HT-004 or HT-016. LMTD returns dT_lm for a counterflow or co-current pair; F_LMTD_Fakheri needs R, N_tubes_passes and NTU as inputs (ht solves them internally - here they are arguments, so no iteration is needed); Ft_aircooler is the crossflow analogue fitted for air coolers. refs: Fakheri,_split-shell correction (as in Ludwig/Hemming); GPSA Engineering Data Book (Ft); Incropera et al. (LMTD). overlap: TSP-029 (Quoilin 2011 smoothed LMTD) and LTP-042 (F-LMTD) - the library has no F-correction function; CSL-0002/CSL-0026/CSL-0027 use epsilon-NTU instead of LMTD.

title: Conduction: cylindrical wall, plane-wall resistance, 6 shape factors (sphere/pipe to plane, pipe to pipe, eccentric) and R-value unit conversions
description: 14 functions: R_to_k, k_to_R, k_to_thermal_resistivity, thermal_resistivity_to_k, R_value_to_k, k_to_R_value, R_cylinder, S_isothermal_sphere_to_plane, S_isothermal_pipe_to_plane, S_isothermal_pipe_normal_to_plane, S_isothermal_pipe_to_isothermal_pipe, S_isothermal_pipe_to_two_planes, S_isothermal_pipe_eccentric_to_isothermal_pipe, cylindrical_heat_transfer. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; cylindrical_heat_transfer is the core (Q = dT/ln(Di/Do)/ln(...)... with the inner and outer convection coefficients); the 6 shape factors return a dimensionless S used with a distance; the 6 R/k conversions are trivial but accept imperial units (Btu, ft, inch) - keep the SI branch only and document the conversion. ht/units.py re-exports 3 of them as deprecated aliases (R_to_k, R_value_to_k, k_to_R_value) - do not translate twice. refs: Incropera et al. and VDI Heat Atlas (shape factors); ASHRAE tables (R-value). overlap: CSL-0042/CSL-0012 (building models) compute conduction inline; LTP-047 pipe heat loss. No conduction function exists.

title: Radiation: blackbody spectral radiance, radiant heat flux between surfaces (with back-radiation) and grey transmittance
description: 3 functions: blackbody_spectral_radiance, q_rad, grey_transmittance. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; only 3 functions (below target): merge into HT-020 if desired. q_rad needs an emissivity, a surface temperature and an environment temperature (blackbody or another emissivity); blackbody_spectral_radiance returns W/m^2/sr/micrometre and grey_transmittance an attenuation exponent. refs: Incropera et al. (radiative exchange); ht radiation.py. excluded: solar_spectrum (1.4 MB ISS solar spectrum data file, not a correlation). overlap: none - the library has no radiation function.

title: Forced convection in packed beds (Gnielinski, Wakao-Kagei, Achenbach, KTA)
description: 4 functions: Nu_packed_bed_Gnielinski, Nu_Wakao_Kagei, Nu_Achenbach, Nu_KTA. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; only 4 functions (below target) and of little use for the cycle models of the library - low priority. Inputs: particle diameter, bed void fraction, fluid properties, particle-to-fluid temperature ratio. refs: Gnielinski (as cited in Perry's); Wakao & Kagei 1962; Achenbach 1971; KTA (Kessel & Thodos as presented in ht). overlap: none.

title: Fin efficiency of a circular fin (Kern-Kraus) and the wall correction factors for heat transfer and pressure drop
description: 3 functions: fin_efficiency_Kern_Kraus, wall_factor_Nu, wall_factor_fd. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; only 3 functions (below target): consider merging into HT-005 or HT-008 (they are used by the pipe and crossflow correlations). wall_factor_Nu applies to internal flow (Re, Pr, Di/Do), wall_factor_fd to frictional pressure drop and needs a relative roughness. refs: Kern & Kraus (as in Perry's); Chato (cooled tubes) as presented in ht core.py. selector not translated: wall_factor (dispatcher for the two wall factors).

title: Shell-and-tube mechanical sizing: tube counts and bundle diameters (Perry, VDI, HEDH, Phadkeb excluded), clearances, baffle thickness, unsupported tube length, TEMA tube check
description: 13 functions: check_tubing_TEMA, DBundle_min, shell_clearance, baffle_thickness, D_baffle_holes, L_unsupported_max, Ntubes_Perrys, Ntubes_VDI, D_for_Ntubes_VDI, Ntubes_HEDH, DBundle_for_Ntubes_HEDH, Ntubes, size_bundle_from_tubecount. Each becomes one EES FUNCTION (SI arguments) with a comment block giving its formula, validity range and both references (original paper/book + ht module and function).
notes: difficulty=easy; these are geometric estimates, not heat-transfer correlations - low priority. shell_clearance reads a small table of TEMA shell types. refs: Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook; VDI Heat Atlas; HEDH (Schlünder); TEMA. excluded (table/iteration): get_tube_TEMA (BWG wall gauge table), Ntubes_Phadkeb and DBundle_for_Ntubes_Phadkeb (binary .npy lookup tables + helper _load_coeffs_Phadkeb, _tubecount_objf_Perry, to_solve_Ntubes_Phadkeb). overlap: LTP-069/LTP-070 (LaboThapPy shell-and-tube sizing by PSO) - same intent, different method.
